register_run_id: register a run ID for the Bolt checkpoint and set it as the default in the InstanceIdtoRunIdRegistry
register_trace_logger: register a TraceLoggingService instance with the Bolt checkpoint and override the default in TraceLoggingRegistry
param_to_instance_id: extract an instance ID from kwargs by inspecting BoltCreateInstanceArgs, BoltPlayerArgs, BoltJob, or BoltHookCommonInjectionArgs objects
use_as_decorator: use bolt_checkpoint as a decorator on sync or async functions to automatically write checkpoint trace logging data
review_bolt_checkpoint_class: review the bolt_checkpoint class which extends write_checkpoint to add Bolt-specific instance ID extraction and registry defaults
